snapshot.interpretation: Stage 1 Product Reality Audit, Stage 2 Installation + First Run, and Stage 3 Model / Provider Setup are closed. The only active predefined stage is Stage 4 Core User Experience. Do not reopen architecture, provider onboarding, or D1 unless a current P0/P1 proves it necessary.

titan_v1_execution_contract.goal: Finish Titan as an ordinary-user product rather than indefinitely improving architecture.
titan_v1_execution_contract.mandatory_scope_rule: Only P0/P1 findings that block the current V1 user scenario, safety/authority/data integrity, install/run, recovery, pilot, or release may create required work.
titan_v1_execution_contract.finish_condition: P0=0, P1=0, bounded pilot passed, target product dimensions reached, then TITAN V1 — DONE.

user_capability_now: supported provider selection through one local configurator
hidden API-key entry rather than command-line secret exposure
explicit ALLOW consent before remote-data policy changes
deterministic existing-policy configuration for real remote chat
preservation of VELANTRIM_API_KEY, VELANTRIM_ALLOW_OPEN and unrelated env settings
canonical provider setup guide and actionable policy-denial recovery
preserved_boundaries: no consent broker or new authority
fail-closed defaults remain until explicit opt-in

maturity_estimates.note: Engineering estimates only; not formal authorization metrics.

current_workstream.name: CORE_USER_EXPERIENCE
current_workstream.human_goal: An ordinary user can open Console, understand the primary action, send a task/message, receive a truthful useful result, distinguish local/offline from remote-model output, and continue the interaction without needing internal architecture knowledge.
current_workstream.scope_rule: Audit and fix only P0/P1 blockers in the existing core user loop. Do not expand into files/tools (Stage 5), restart persistence (Stage 6), failure matrix (Stage 7), packaging (Stage 8), or new capabilities.
next_actions: inspect exact current Console bootstrap/chat interaction and its tests
map the ordinary-user happy path from opened Console to useful result
apply the smallest bounded fix if required
run exact-head CI/CodeQL/aggregate before Stage 4 closure

remaining_v1_p1.name: Legacy TruthGate duplicate evidence-token cardinality (D1)
remaining_v1_p1.bounded_rule: Exact-string duplicate-cardinality normalization only; no EvidenceReference/EvidenceAdmission architecture expansion.

p2_p3_backlog_not_mandatory_for_v1: full typed EvidenceReference to Evidence Admission architecture
stop_conditions: do not treat this document as live proof
do not treat percentages as authorization
do not reopen architecture unless a current P0/P1 proves it necessary
do not resume D1 before Stage 5
do not infer production authorization from CI, merge, validation, receipt, or pilot
after Stage 11 closure do not invent an additional mandatory stage
